sun.net.www.content.text

类 PlainTextInputStream

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.io.InputStream
      • java.io.FilterInputStream
        • sun.net.www.content.text.PlainTextInputStream
  • 所有已实现的接口:
    Closeable, AutoCloseable

    public class PlainTextInputStream
extends FilterInputStream
    PlainTextInputStream class extends the FilterInputStream class. Currently all calls to the PlainTextInputStream object will call the corresponding methods in the FilterInputStream class. Hence for now its use is more semantic.
    作者:
    Sunita Mani
